title: Nurse.com Jobs Scraper
description: Collect nursing job listings from Nurse.com with a keyword, a location, or a Nurse.com jobs browse URL.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Nurse.com jobs browse URL. Used only when keyword and location are both empty.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job title, nursing specialty, or search phrase. Takes precedence over startUrl.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, state, or ZIP code. Takes precedence over startUrl.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of jobs
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of unique jobs to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of result pages to request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings for request routing.
